title: Cheapest Gyms Wellington
meta_desc: Find the most affordable gyms in Wellington with no contract options, prices, and discounts. Compare gym chains and get the best deal with Exercise NZ subsidy.
intro: Wellington has a competitive gym market with various options to suit different budgets and preferences. For those looking for affordability without long-term commitment, there are several no-contract gyms available. The Exercise NZ subsidy offers the biggest discount for eligible members, with 40-70% off.

sections.heading: Most Affordable Options
sections.body: The cheapest gym option in Wellington is City Fitness, offering a month-to-month membership for $18.99 per week. Jetts is another affordable option with a no-contract membership and currently has a promotion of 15% off plus 4 weeks free. Snap Fitness also offers 6 weeks free, making it a competitive choice for those on a budget.

sections.heading: No-Contract Alternatives
sections.body: For those who prefer flexibility, several gyms in Wellington offer no-contract memberships. Jetts and Les Mills Flexi Membership are popular choices, allowing members to cancel anytime without penalty. City Fitness also offers a month-to-month membership with no lock-in contract.
list: Les Mills Flexi Membership: no lock-in contract

sections.heading: Exercise NZ Subsidy
sections.body: With the subsidy, members can enjoy significant savings on their gym membership, making it more affordable to stay active and healthy. For example, a $20 per week membership could be reduced to as low as $6 per week with the maximum 70% subsidy.

sections.heading: Price Comparison
sections.body: To help you make an informed decision, we've compiled a price comparison table of gym chains available in Wellington.
